question: Who, joined with svāhā power, should always protect the wife?
premises: The sacred syllable oṃ is invoked
A feminine power joined with svāhā is addressed
Protection of the wife is requested at all times
inference: The goddess united with svāhā power is invoked to always protect the wife.
uncertainties: dārān may refer to wife or spouses in general
plain_english: Oṃ, may she who is united with the power of svāhā always protect the wife.
